title: selliguea albara
intro: Selliguea albara, commonly known as the 'Wild Ginger', is a type of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea albara include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic properties, which make it effective in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
